entity.name: vatryok
entity.description: Independent open source developer building production-grade Python infrastructure. I created Gravtory to solve a real problem I faced: durable, crash-safe workflow execution without the overhead of message brokers or managed services. The project is actively used in production and I am seeking funding to continue full-time development.

projects.name: Gravtory
projects.description: Production-grade durable workflow engine for Python. Atomic checkpointing, saga compensation, parallel execution, and distributed workers — all powered by your existing database. No message broker required. Gravtory delivers Temporal-grade reliability as a single pip install, supporting PostgreSQL, SQLite, MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis backends. Built-in dashboard, OpenTelemetry support, type-safe API, in-memory testing framework, and native LLM/AI workflow support.
